title: BaseHTTPMiddleware request-body ownership: broad scope cache rejected, narrow call_next replay delivered

boundary_decision.rationale: Issue 495, rejected PR 500, and merged PR 1692 form one request-body ownership lineage: the broad scope-cache attempt was punted over streaming semantics, while the later implementation narrowed replay to BaseHTTPMiddleware.call_next and survived a multi-chunk review correction.
boundary_decision.falsification: Split the lineage if immutable patch or timestamped review evidence shows PR 1692 did not address the middleware-first body-consumption path reported in Issue 495, or if PR 500 was independently merged or delivered elsewhere in Starlette.

source_body_history_limitations: Issue and PR bodies are mutable. GitHub's current structured record for Issue 495 exposes the original datePublished/bodyVersion and no content-edit record; immediate comments independently anchor the second-Request diagnosis. PR 1692 creation records only that a candidate opened; its current body/title/commit list are not backfilled into 2022. The timestamped rename, comments, original review commit, final patch, approval, merge, and close are separate sources. Timeline events use documented canonical JSON subsets.
